Container.Name: nomad_disk_collector
Container.Overview: Optional helper for Project N.O.M.A.D. Every 2 minutes it reads your disks and filesystem usage (read-only) and writes a small JSON file into NOMAD's storage folder, so the Command Center can show disk info. It needs no network.[br][br] The Storage path must be exactly the same as the Storage path in the nomad_admin template.

Config.Name: Host root (read-only)
Config.Description: Read-only view of the host filesystem, used to read disk and mount info.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Must be exactly the same as the Storage path in nomad_admin.
